hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A custom-curve hook for ETH/phiEth pools implementing 1:1 swapping via the phiEth wrapper's deposit/withdraw. In beforeSwap, the hook takes input from the pool manager, converts it, and settles the output — bypassing the AMM entirely. Liquidity additions are blocked; the pool is restricted to ETH/phiEth pairs with zero fee.
